from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Overlay foreground marks at matching positions in panels around a divider."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if grid[0][c] != 0 and
                    all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)
    if divider is None:
        raise ValueError("no solid vertical divider")
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    if any(len(a) != len(b) for a, b in zip(left, right)):
        raise ValueError("panels are not equal width")
    bg_left = Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg_right = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[2 if a != bg_left and b != bg_right else 0
             for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
            for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
